title.narrative: North Gondar Integrated Emergency Response Project (NGIERP)

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspangtThe devastating impact of the Tigray conflict and the ongoing hostilities between the government and unidentified armed groups coupled with natural hazards (especially drought) resulted in a situation, where millions of people face a deterioration of livelihoods and life-threatening challenges. The North Gondar Zone Disaster Risk Management Office (DRMO) reported that thousands of people were exposed to food, health and health-related problems including outbreaks of diseases, and trauma because of the drought and related hazards. Moreover, human right abuses, gender-based violence, poverty, and reduced access to basic social services were also reported.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe objective of the project is to provide critical emergency life-saving assistance to the most vulnerable population in the North Gondar zone through integrated multi-sectoral project interventions. In coordination with the respective clusters and the cash working group, the project will deliver health, multi-purpose cash and WASH assistance to communities in Telemt, Beyeda and Janamora woredas. In relation to the health sector, FH will contribute to the health cluster objective by ensuring equitable access and delivering life-saving essential mental health services, to all persons in need, including IDPS, returnees and the host community. FHE will also respond to the prevention and control of cholera, malaria and measles outbreak in the affected woredas in N Gonder through community SBC interventions and capacity building of woreda offices to control the outbreak. FHE will also support by transporting emergency health kits including inter agency emergency health kits, cholera kits and malaria kits from WHO ware house to the implementation woredas. ltbrgtltbrgtIn order to support the affected people to cover food and other basic necessities, FH will transfer unrestricted multipurpose cash (MPC) to 1050 households. The MPC helps the target familiesltspangt meet their basic household needs (e.g. food, livelihoods, health, WASH, education, SNFIs) as they see fit. The designated amount is decided based on Ethiopia’s Cash Working Group (CWG) recommendations and regularly transferred to recipients’ bank accounts in two rounds installments.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtIn response to the critical shortage of WASH services, FH will engage in rehabilitation of water schemes and support hygiene and sanitation. The rehabilitation of water sources is a key intervention which determines the other WASH services, because it would be difficult to maintain improved sanitation and hygienic conditions in a water-scarce situation. FH will provide multipurpose soap, water treatment supplies, Spring Maintenance, Shallow well rehabilitation, Local capacity building on water sources management and also promoting key hygiene and sanitation practices. ltbrgtThe project will support 179,918 conflict and drought affected people in the three Woredas in North Gondar for ten months with a total budget of $800,000.ltbrgtlt/pgt
